text:
Before a hard conversation with a landlord or a manager, rehearse it out loud. Open voice mode in ChatGPT and say:

Play [person]. I'm going to ask for [what I want]. Push back the way they realistically would. After 5 back-and-forths, step out of character and tell me where I sounded unsure.

Run it twice and the real one feels familiar. Who would you most want to practice with?
